newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan temperatures seen above average to Feb 10.
newsitem.headline: Japan temperatures seen above average to Feb 10.

text.p: Temperatures are forecast to be higher-than-average throughout most of Japan during the one-month period until February 10, the Meteorological Agency said on Monday.
The southernmost Ryukyu islands are likely to see average temperatures and rainfall, the agency said.
Precipitation is forecast to be lower-than-average and sunshine plentiful in northern and eastern regions along the Sea of Japan coast, it said.
Northern and eastern areas areas facing the Pacific Ocean, together with western Japan, are expected to see higher-than-average rainfall during the one-month period, the agency said.
